name: genotype-perturbation-response
title: Genotype perturbation response: how v2ecoli responds to KO, KD, and OE of native genes

studies.genotype-00-build-integrity: AUTHORED. Does a ParCa-level knockout reconstruct into a self-consistent sim_data? Graded, not descriptive - the round-trip and inventory invariants are right or wrong independently of biology. Gates everything below.

studies.genotype-01-control-panel: AUTHORED. A control panel spanning gene classes - a no-op perturbation plus well-characterized knockouts - confirming the machinery moves the cell only where it should before anything is read into a result. (Authored under the slug genotype-01-control-panel; this entry previously named a planned genotype-01-null-control.)

studies.genotype-02-essentiality-panel: PLANNED. Single-gene knockouts spanning known-essential, known-non-essential and known-conditional genes; characterize the model's response using published essentiality as structure to read against.

studies.genotype-03-aa-pathway-stress: PLANNED. Knockouts of amino-acid pathway genes, probing the mechanistic AA supply parameter-fitting interaction flagged in RFC-007. Checked at build time (fitting integrity) and downstream (physiology).

studies.genotype-04-ko-mechanism-comparison: PLANNED. The same genes knocked out translationally and at the ParCa level; characterize where and how far the two mechanisms diverge.

studies.genotype-05-knockdown-dose-response: PLANNED. Graded knockdown of a small gene set; characterize the shape of the response across the multiplier series.

studies.genotype-06-trpr-regulon: AUTHORED (design complete, runs not yet executed). Slug is all-lowercase per the workspace convention; the gene is trpR. Knockout of a transcriptional regulator rather than an enzyme. Expected to disagree with data, for a mechanistic reason worth pinning: the deletion transform never prunes fold_changes, so ParCa keeps fitting the trpR regulon after trpR is gone. Sibling of genotype-03 - that one probes the enzymes of the tryptophan pathway, this one probes its regulator.

glossary.definition: Deletion of a gene from the chromosome before reconstruction - the sequence is spliced out, coordinates of downstream features shift, and ParCa fits parameters for a genome that no longer contains the gene. Contrast the translation-level knockout, which zeroes a translation efficiency on the live process and leaves transcription intact.

Whether a perturbed genotype reconstructs into a self-consistent sim_data - coordinates internally consistent, sequence uncorrupted, ParCa fit converged, fitted parameters in range - independently of whether the resulting physiology is sensible.

Two-branch check over every coordinate-bearing feature after a deletion. A feature whose length is unchanged must be byte-identical; a feature that shrank must equal its original with exactly the deleted span excised. Only the second branch detects an off-by-one splice, because an off-by-one preserves every length.
The hash of the complete ecoli-sources bundle manifest a genotype is built from. One hash, fully reproducible, campaign-pinnable - genotype = bundle = ParCa build = study.

biological_story: Deleting a gene from a chromosome is not the same operation as silencing its product. The chromosome is a coordinate system: genes sit inside transcription units, transcription units overlap one another, and regulatory sites are addressed by position. Removing a span renumbers everything downstream of it and truncates whatever straddles the cut, so a knockout at the reconstruction level propagates into operon structure, transcription-unit boundaries, and the fitted parameters that depend on them - none of which a translation-level knockout touches. That difference is the reason this investigation exists: the two mechanisms answer different biological questions, and the model's response to each is a claim about how faithfully it represents genome organization rather than just gene dosage. The first study asks the prior question - whether a perturbed genome reconstructs into a coherent parameter set at all - because every downstream physiological reading is conditional on that.
question: When a native gene is knocked out, knocked down, or overexpressed in v2ecoli, how does the cell respond? Specifically: does a genotype built at the ParCa level yield a self-consistent sim_data at all; what does the model do across a panel of genes whose essentiality is independently known; what happens when the perturbed genes feed the mechanistic amino-acid supply parameters; and how do the two available knockout mechanisms - translation-level and ParCa-level - differ in effect?

executive.what_is_this: A characterization of the genotype-perturbation machinery and of the model's response to it. The arc runs from build integrity - does a perturbed genotype reconstruct into a coherent sim_data - through a descriptive pass over panels with independent structure to read against, into targeted probes of the two places the model is most likely to be wrong. Deliberately DESCRIPTIVE past the first study. Studies 01-06 characterize behaviour and are not structured as graded evaluations returning verdicts; each carries several independent checks, any of which can surface a divergence worth acting on. That is the intended yield - a ranked list of things to look at, not a pass/fail. Committing bands before real readouts exist would mostly be speculative structure, rewritten once the first numbers land. genotype-00 is the exception and is graded, because "did the build stay self-consistent" has answers that are right or wrong independently of biology.

decisions_needed.question: How does a study declare WHICH genotype it builds?
decisions_needed.context: Was blocking genotype-00 execution: the `parca` generator accepted exactly `debug`, `cpus`, `cache_dir`, so a knockout build was indistinguishable from a wild-type one in `conditions.baseline.params`, and genotype-00 had to record its genotype as a gate: required-before-run model_setting instead. RESOLVED by adding `bundle_manifest` / `bundle_overrides` to the generator, threaded into InitializeStep's config, plus a cross-check that warns when the declared manifest disagrees with the bundle the injected raw_data was actually built from - the failure that would otherwise attribute a sim_data to a genotype it was not built from. genotype-00 now declares its genotype in params for both conditions. Smaller than this entry anticipated: the RUNNER (`v2ecoli-parca --bundle-manifest-path`) already accepted a manifest, so only the study surface was missing it. Two things it deliberately does NOT do, which the remaining gates cover: the declaration is structural rather than effective (driving ParCa from a study is out of scope), and nothing yet PRODUCES a knockout manifest - that is the ecoli-sources KO generator.

decisions_needed.question: Which gene panel for the essentiality study, and at what size?
decisions_needed.context: An informative panel mixes confidently-essential, confidently-non-essential, and known-conditional genes rather than sampling uniformly, since the conditional cases are where a whole-cell model can say something a flux-balance model cannot. Panel size trades directly against seeds and generations per genotype.

decisions_needed.question: What readouts best express 'the model treated this gene as essential'?
decisions_needed.status: OPEN - expected to be informed BY the descriptive pass, not before it
decisions_needed.context: A whole-cell model does not return a binary. Candidates include failure to divide within the simulated window, doubling time beyond some band, and mass-accumulation arrest. Rather than pick one up front, the descriptive pass should report several and show what they look like across known-essential and known-non-essential genes. Choosing the criterion is then grounded in observed separation instead of guessed. Note also that at the ParCa level an essential-gene knockout may fail to BUILD rather than fail to grow - a genotype-00 outcome, qualitatively unlike the translation-level knockout's outcome.

decisions_needed.question: Does a ParCa-level TF knockout prune that TF's regulon entries?
decisions_needed.status: OPEN - the BEHAVIOUR is now measured (it does NOT prune; all 7 trpR fold_changes rows survive a trpR deletion, because the transform never touches fold_changes). What stays open is the JUDGEMENT - defect or defensible modelling choice - which genotype-06-trpr-regulon carries as design_pivot_required GENO06-EQ-01.
decisions_needed.context: fold_changes.tsv is keyed by TF COMMON NAME (trpR has 7 target entries: trpA -1.83, trpB -1.77, trpC -1.63, ...), and the chromosome-deletion transform touches only genes, transcription_units, dna_sites and the genome sequence. So a ParCa-level knockout of a transcription factor deletes the gene while ParCa continues to fit delta_prob entries for a regulator that no longer exists in the genome. Whether that is a defect or a defensible modelling choice needs deciding for every TF knockout, not just trpR.

scientific_argument.main_claim: Descriptive investigation - no verdict claim is asserted past build integrity. The intended output is a characterization of the model's genotype-perturbation response, plus a ranked list of divergences worth acting on.
caveats: genotype-00, genotype-01 and genotype-06 are authored; the rest are named targets, not artifacts. genotype-00 and genotype-01 have run; genotype-06's findings are static measurements of the model's own parameter tables, and its run arms are not yet executed.

Published essentiality is used as independent structure to read results against, not as a grading key. It IS genuinely independent - the model is not fit to it - which is what would make a later graded comparison meaningful, and why it is worth reaching for even in a descriptive pass.

Reference strain matters: published single-gene knockout collections are in BW25113, not MG1655. Strain mismatch is a real confounder for a minority of genes and should be recorded alongside results rather than silently absorbed.

genotype-04 is a model-to-model comparison. There is no ground truth for which knockout mechanism is "right", so it characterizes divergence and cannot return a correctness verdict - but the divergence itself is informative, since a translation-level knockout still transcribes mRNA and consumes RNAP capacity where a ParCa-level knockout removes the gene entirely.

genotype-03 and genotype-06 test anticipated failure modes, so negative results there are expected and useful outcomes rather than project risks. Each is scoped as its own study precisely so it cannot be quietly skipped.

studies.name: genotype-00-build-integrity
studies.title: Does a ParCa-level knockout reconstruct into a self-consistent sim_data?
studies.question: When a gene is deleted from the chromosome and the ParCa is rebuilt on the perturbed genome, does the resulting sim_data stay self-consistent? Concretely: is every retained feature's sequence exactly what it should be, does the feature inventory change by exactly the expected amount, does every coordinate still lie inside the shortened chromosome, and does the fit converge with its parameters in range - before any physiological reading is attempted.

findings.statement: A ParCa-level lacY knockout builds end to end through the supplier-side generator path - bundle generation (<1 s, content-addressed), all 9 ParCa steps (78 s fast regime), mechanistic fits ok - and the reconstructed knowledge base passes every structural integrity axis: two-branch sequence round trip (0 corrupted features across genes, TUs and DNA sites), exact 1254 bp chromosome shortening, all coordinates in bounds, and functional absence of the deleted gene via the tombstone mechanism.

evidence.observed: Card verdict within_tol (5/5 graded structural axes); WT and KO arms built 2026-08-14, runtimes.json 78 s each.

findings.next_action: Grade the two ParCa-fit axes against a full-mode build when one is warranted; until then they stay ungraded/PARTIAL by design. The descriptive studies (01-06) now have a working build path to run against.

derived.insight: A ParCa-level lacY knockout builds end to end through the supplier-side generator path - bundle generation (<1 s, content-addressed), all 9 ParCa steps (78 s fast regime), mechanistic fits ok - and the reconstructed knowledge base passes every structural integrity axis: two-branch sequence round trip (0 corrupted features across genes, TUs and DNA sites), exact 1254 bp chromosome shortening, all coordinates in bounds, and functional absence of the deleted gene via the tombstone mechanism.

studies.name: genotype-01-control-panel
studies.title: What do ParCa-level knockout mechanics look like across control gene classes?
studies.question: When genes of three verified classes are knocked out at the ParCa level - (A) expressed but functionally unwired in the model, (B) wired into metabolism but biologically non-essential, (C) essential machinery with three distinct mechanisms (RNA polymerase, ribosome, replisome) - what do the build mechanics actually do? Does every class build? Does the fit converge? How large is the expression perturbation beyond the deleted gene (the refit-artifact floor)? And is anything general or surprising in how the mechanics differ across classes?

findings.statement: In-model essentiality can only live in explicitly wired machinery: the classification scan for this panel found tufA (EF-Tu), fusA (EF-G), infC (IF-3), and ftsZ are expression-only - no functional wiring in complexation, metabolism, regulation, two-component, equilibrium, or any functional molecule group - so knocking out these biologically essential genes would read as inert. Conversely dnaG, which a complexation-only scan misses, is directly consumed as a replisome monomer subunit.

evidence.observed: Participation scan over the full-condition fixture sim_data, 2026-08-17: 3,386 functionally referenced species after excluding the bulk_molecules_binomial_division inventory (16,321 entries - every bulk molecule, which had masked all distinctions).

findings.next_action: Holds interpretation weight for every KO study: absence of model response to a KO must be checked against wiring before being read as a model prediction.

findings.statement: The knockout mechanics are uniform and structurally sound across every gene class: all 8 genotypes generate bundles, and all 8 grade within_tol on every fit-free structural axis (round trip, chromosome length, bounds, tombstone, functional absence) - including the four whose ParCa fit later crashes. The genome-surgery layer is class-independent.

A ParCa-level knockout of ANY ppGpp-regulated gene crashes the build at step 3: set_ppgpp_expression (transcription.py:1935) indexes its fold-change table by cistron id, the deleted gene's cistron has left the functional index, and the lookup raises KeyError('<gene>_RNA'). 393 genes (~8% of the genome) are in ppgpp_regulated_genes, so this is the blast radius. The class-C "essentiality" signal is entirely preempted by this crash - cspA (class A: functionally unwired, biologically dispensable at 37C) fails identically to rpoB/rplB/dnaG, proving the failure is regulon membership, not essentiality. This is the first FATAL instance of the D17 dangling-reference class (the generator prunes nothing by design; consequences are this investigation's subject matter), and what "essential machinery" would do in the model remains unobserved.

evidence.observed: Identical failure tails for cspA, rpoB, rplB, dnaG (KeyError on EG10166_RNA / EG10894_RNA / EG10865_RNA / EG10239_RNA respectively); --allow-partial-fit does not help (the crash precedes the fit). len(ppgpp_regulated_genes) = 393 (8.7% of the 4538 functional cistrons; 4747 raw genes would give 8.3% - the cistron set is the one set_ppgpp_expression indexes, so it is the operative denominator). Crash-vs-regulon-membership agrees 8/8 with ZERO mismatches across the panel. Committed backing: data/evidence.json E-1, regenerated by sims/extract_evidence.py.

findings.next_action: FILED as v2ecoli#536 (composition defect: KO generator x set_ppgpp_expression - same family as v2ecoli#490's DnaA-box drop, but fatal rather than silent). Scoped there: the sibling TF fold-change loader (simulation_data.py:146-190) already carries the coordinate guard this site lacks, so a TF knockout does NOT crash - it drops the affected fold-change entries silently instead, behind VERBOSE=False. One-site fix, not a sweep. Candidate fixes belong to the consumer per the D17/#468 precedent: skip or renormalize fold-change entries whose cistron left the functional set. Until fixed, panel and screen gene lists must exclude ppgpp_regulated_genes or expect a build failure - which the runner already records as a result.

findings.statement: The refit artifact for a functionally-inert knockout has a clean three-part structure: (a) a per-mille bulk shift (median relative expression delta 0.02-0.16% across the four builders, scaling with the deleted gene's freed expression share), (b) ~10-12% shifts confined to the deleted gene's OPERON NEIGHBORS (ygiB's tail is ygiC and tolC - transcription-unit share reattribution after TU truncation), and (c) large relative deltas on numerically-zero cistrons (1e-24-scale expression) that mean nothing. The wired-but-nonessential class (pgi, tpiA - genes with real growth defects) is barely distinguishable from a chemotaxis gene at the expression level, consistent with the expectation that the model under-reacts to their loss.

evidence.observed: expression_delta_vs_wt in data/panel_summary.json: ygiB median 2.1e-4 / pgi 9.2e-4 / tpiA 1.6e-3 / cheY 8.2e-4; >5% tails 0.1-0.3% of cistrons; ygiB's >5% tail is 9 cistrons, of which exactly 2 carry real expression: ygiC (EG11165_RNA) and tolC (EG11009_RNA), both at 12.35%; the other 7 sit below a 1e-12 zero floor and their relative deltas are meaningless. Committed backing: data/evidence.json E-2, regenerated by sims/extract_evidence.py.

findings.next_action: Directly actionable for the Ambr250 comparison's DEG grading: mask the target's operon neighbors and near-zero cistrons, and treat the per-mille bulk as the artifact floor. Growth-rate-level under-reaction (pgi/tpiA) is a simulation-layer question, out of scope for a ParCa-only panel. Scope, now measured rather than argued (2026-08-18): the magnitudes are MODE-INDEPENDENT. A same-commit full-mode WT/ygiB-KO control reproduces this contrast to full float precision, not merely to four significant figures: median relative delta 2.1025575e-04 and >5% tail 0.210% are IDENTICAL in fast and full, the named tail is ygiC/tolC at 12.35% in both, and full-vs-fast basal WT expression is bit-identical (max relative delta exactly 0.0). So both the structure (TU-neighbor concentration, mechanism-derived) and the numbers carry over; consumers may use them directly. Committed backing: data/evidence.json E-3.

studies.claim: Knockout mechanics are structurally sound and class-independent (8/8 genotypes pass every fit-free integrity axis), but a step-3 dangling-reference crash in set_ppgpp_expression blocks the build for ALL ~393 ppGpp-regulated genes (~8% of the genome) - preempting any in-model essentiality signal - and the refit artifact for inert knockouts is per-mille in the bulk with ~10% shifts confined to the target's operon neighbors.

derived.insight: In-model essentiality can only live in explicitly wired machinery: the classification scan for this panel found tufA (EF-Tu), fusA (EF-G), infC (IF-3), and ftsZ are expression-only - no functional wiring in complexation, metabolism, regulation, two-component, equilibrium, or any functional molecule group - so knocking out these biologically essential genes would read as inert. Conversely dnaG, which a complexation-only scan misses, is directly consumed as a replisome monomer subunit.

studies.name: genotype-06-trpr-regulon
studies.title: How does v2ecoli realize a transcription-factor knockout?
studies.question: When the perturbed gene is a transcriptional regulator rather than an enzyme, how does v2ecoli realize the knockout, and how much of that regulator's documented biology can the model represent at all? Concretely, for trpR: by which routes can the genotype be built, what does each route let us observe, and what does the model's own regulatory parameterization put out of reach of every route?

resolved_uncertainties: Whether a ParCa-level TF knockout prunes that TF's regulon entries. It does NOT - the deletion transform touches genes, transcription_units, dna_sites and the genome sequence, and never fold_changes. All 12 trpR rows survive a trpR deletion, so ParCa continues fitting delta_prob entries for a regulator no longer in the genome. This closes an open decision on the parent investigation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the inverted table ordering (F-03) manifests as an inverted RUN response once attenuation is enabled, or whether downstream machinery re-weights the two mechanisms.
Whether ParCa's continued fitting of an absent regulator's regulon is a defect or a defensible modelling choice. It needs deciding for every TF knockout, not just trpR.

followup_study_proposals.title: VOID - the TrpR->mtr edge already exists
followup_study_proposals.motivation: ⛔ This proposal rested on the retracted half of F-02. mtr is repressed by trpR at 3.89x in the table the model loads, so there is no edge to add and B2 was never unreachable. Retained rather than deleted so the reasoning error stays visible: it was derived from fold_changes.tsv alone, and the model also loads fold_changes_nca.tsv.

followup_study_proposals.title: Re-parameterize the TrpR fold-changes toward the literature range
followup_study_proposals.motivation: F-03 shows the magnitudes are an order of magnitude low AND inverted against attenuation. A re-parameterization would test both at once, and because operon polarity is already correct it is a scaling question rather than a structural one.

followup_study_proposals.title: Reproduce and characterize the route-A TRP[c] build failure
followup_study_proposals.motivation: F-05 records a real measured ParCa failure that currently has no public artifact. The underlying amino-acid parameterization looks foundational and is out of scope here, but the failure itself should be reproducible on demand rather than remembered.

findings.statement: v2ecoli's transcriptional-regulatory network covers 2198 of 4347 mRNA cistrons - 50.6%. It is 4209 edges from 150 transcription factors onto 2231 distinct target names. ⛔ An earlier version of this finding reported 663 of 4347 (15.2%) from 47 TFs; that was measured from fold_changes.tsv ALONE and was wrong - see the correction note below.
findings.next_action: The ceiling this investigation operates under is roughly half the genome, not ~15%. That is a materially different framing of the model's mechanistic reach and belongs in the investigation's own framing rather than only here.

evidence.observed: Both fold-change tables merged as the loader merges them (simulation_data.py:191 iterates ["fold_changes", "fold_changes_nca"], NCA second so it wins on overlap), minus fold_changes_removed.tsv: 4209 edges, 150 TFs, 2231 distinct targets, 2198 of which resolve to mRNA cistrons out of 4347. Re-derivable via sims/extract_evidence.py.

findings.statement: The model's trpR regulon is 12 edges and covers ALL FIVE of EcoCyc's TrpR operator regions - trpLEDCBA, aroH, aroL, mtr, and trpR's own negative autoregulation - plus aroM and yaiA. ⛔ An earlier version of this finding claimed 7 edges over 2 of 5 regions, and that aroL, mtr and trpR carried no regulatory edge from any transcription factor. That was wrong in both halves; all three are repressed by trpR in the table the model actually loads.
findings.next_action: The regulon is structurally complete against EcoCyc. Whatever divergence this study finds is therefore a PARAMETERIZATION question, not a coverage one - which is a cleaner result than the original claim and removes the "unreachable by any route" framing entirely.

evidence.observed: Effective trpR targets after merging both tables and applying fold_changes_removed: yaiA 4.03x, trpA 3.94x, trpC 3.89x, mtr 3.89x, trpB 3.78x, trpR 3.73x, trpD 3.71x, trpL 3.68x, aroH 3.46x, trpE 3.41x, aroM 2.77x, aroL 2.62x. The NCA table supplies aroL, aroM, mtr, trpR and yaiA, and overwrites all seven shared targets.

findings.statement: In the model's parameter tables the control hierarchy is INVERTED against the literature. TrpR repression terms are 2.62-4.03x where the literature reports 70-300x, while attenuation terms on the same operon are 5.98-7.36x against a literature 8-10x. On all 5 genes where both mechanisms act, the model's attenuation term is LARGER than its repression term - the opposite of the documented ordering.
findings.next_action: Re-parameterizing the TrpR fold-changes toward the literature range would fix the magnitude and the ordering together. Worth noting what the model gets RIGHT first: ⛔ the promoter-proximal-strongest polarity claim is RETRACTED: on the effective merged table the trp operon's terms are nearly flat (3.41-3.94x) and trpE is the WEAKEST, not the strongest. The gradient reported earlier was an artifact of reading fold_changes.tsv alone. It is mis-parameterized, not structurally wrong, on the genes it covers.

evidence.observed: Per shared target, TrpR repression vs attenuation (fold), using the effective merged table: trpA 3.94 vs 7.36, trpB 3.78 vs 6.96, trpC 3.89 vs 7.16, trpD 3.71 vs 6.68, trpE 3.41 vs 5.98. Repression exceeds attenuation on 0 of 5.

findings.statement: tRNA transcriptional attenuation is OFF in a default v2ecoli run. The attenuation terms F-03 measures are present in the shipped tables but inactive unless explicitly enabled, so in a default simulation trp control rests on the TrpR term alone.
findings.next_action: This is why the attenuation-on control arm exists. Without it, a run measuring "weak trp control" would be read as evidence about the balance of two mechanisms when only one was switched on. It also means F-03's inversion is a statement about the TABLES and must not be restated as a statement about a run.

evidence.observed: Three independent defaults agree: v2ecoli/composites/ecoli_baseline.py:506 DEFAULT_FEATURES = ['ppgpp_regulation'] with the explicit comment "trna_attenuation + mass_conservation off by default"; v2ecoli/processes/transcript_initiation.py:378 declares 'trna_attenuation' default False; v2ecoli/composites/_helpers.py:1413 reads ti_config.get('trna_attenuation', False).

findings.statement: Route A - chromosomal deletion of trpR before reconstruction - does not build. Both the trpR single and the trpR+tnaA double fail ParCa at step 9 with an identical ValueError on the amino-acid homeostasis check for TRP[c]. This is a third knockout failure class, distinct from the fatal dangling reference of the ppGpp path and from silent target-side drops: a validated invariant tripping loudly, which is arguably the system working.
findings.next_action: The failure is now reproducible on demand via sims/run_route_a.py, which regenerates the bundles rather than reading any scratch directory. The underlying amino-acid pathway parameterization is out of scope here; what this study owes is the reproducible record.

evidence.observed: REPRODUCED 2026-08-20 in this study, both arms, identically. ParCa exit 1, no parca_state.pkl written, checkpoints 1-8 present and step 9 absent. Assertion verbatim: "ValueError: Check that amino acid concentrations should be lower in amino acid media for ['TRP[c]']". Genotype ids 0adf8b53af80154d (trpR, EG11029) and 70d3080e93e991f3 (trpRtnaA, EG11029+EG11005). Artifact: data/route_a_summary.json.

findings.statement: The route-A failure cleanly separates BUILD INTEGRITY from PARAMETER FITTING. All six structural axes pass within tolerance on both arms - chromosome length, round-trip, coordinate bounds, coordinate shift, tombstone, and functional absence - so the genome splice is sound and the genotype is well-formed. It is ParCa's fit, not the deletion machinery, that rejects it.
findings.next_action: Worth stating plainly because it changes what the failure means: "a trpR knockout does not build" would suggest the perturbation machinery is broken for regulators. It is not. The machinery produces a structurally perfect genotype that a downstream physiological invariant then refuses. INTERPRETATION, offered as such and not measured here: the invariant asserts intracellular amino acid concentrations should be LOWER in amino-acid media, and derepressed trp biosynthesis after losing the repressor is a plausible reason that relation would invert for TRP specifically. Testing that would require instrumenting step 9, which this study does not do.

evidence.observed: Both arms: structural_axes_all_ok true, with chromosome_length.ok, round_trip.ok, coordinate_bounds.ok, coordinate_shift.ok, tombstone.ok and functional_absence.ok all within_tol; fit.completed and fit.conditions_fitted ungraded because no fit completed. Artifact: data/route_a_summary.json.

findings.statement: The model's TrpR regulation WORKS, and the earlier basal null result was correct behaviour rather than a divergence. Removing TrpR in the condition where the model declares it active derepresses the trp operon 6.29x; in basal, where the model declares it inactive, the same knockout changes nothing (1.06x). The knockout itself is total in both - zero TrpR copies against 42-80 in the matched wild type.
findings.next_action: This resolves the alternative hypothesis recorded above: the weak trp response measured in basal was NOT inert regulation, it was a condition with nothing to derepress. The model's own condition_defs.tsv declares CPLX-125 (TrpR's active form) among with_aa's active TFs and none in basal, so basal has no repression to relieve. Both arms of that alternative are now measured rather than reasoned.

evidence.observed: Time-mean trp TU (TU00067) synthesis probability, second-half window, 3 generations, seed 0. AA-replete: WT 6.63e-05, trpR KO 4.17e-04, ratio 6.29x. Basal: WT 5.77e-04, trpR KO 6.14e-04, ratio 1.06x. TrpR monomer: 0 in every KO sample, 42-80 in WT. Fraction of samples with the operon repressed (<1e-8): AA-replete WT 74%, KO 0%. Artifacts: data/route_b_*.json.

findings.statement: The measured derepression (6.29x) is the same order as the ceiling predicted statically from the model's own merged fold-change table (F-02/F-03: 2.62-4.03x), though somewhat above it - the readout is transcription-unit level while the terms are per-target, so they are related but not the same quantity and exact agreement was not expected. Two independent methods - reading the shipped parameter table, and running the knockout - agree. So B1's predicted failure against the literature's 70-300x is a parameterization result, fully accounted for, and not a defect in the knockout machinery or the run.
findings.next_action: This is the strongest form the study's central claim can take: the model under-derepresses by roughly an order of magnitude relative to the literature, and the shortfall is exactly what its own regulatory parameterization permits. FU-02 (re-parameterize the TrpR fold-changes) is the actionable consequence.

evidence.observed: Static (F-02/F-03, both tables merged as the loader merges them): TrpR terms 2.62-4.03x. Dynamic (F-07, from the run): 6.29x. Literature: 70-300x.

studies.claim: A regulator knockout is realizable by three distinct routes in v2ecoli, and the route determines what can be observed. For trpR the model's regulon is structurally complete - 12 edges spanning all 5 of EcoCyc's operator regions - so the divergence from biology is one of parameterization, not coverage: the TrpR repression terms are 2.62-4.03x where the literature reports 70-300x, and on every gene where both mechanisms act the model's attenuation term exceeds its repression term, inverting the documented ordering. The model's mechanistic reach over transcriptional regulation overall is ~51% of mRNA cistrons.

biological_validation.basis: Not asserted. The parent investigation is descriptive and asserts no verdict past build integrity; this study contributes a ranked set of divergences, not a pass/fail on the model.

regression_compatibility.basis: The study changes no shipped code or data. The static pass reads the model's own tables, and the run arms (route A build attempts, route B multigen) execute stock v2ecoli against cache-baked knockouts without modifying it.

explanatory_gain.basis: F-03 identifies a specific, actionable mis-parameterization - the repression/attenuation ordering is inverted on every gene where both act - and F-02 establishes that the regulon is structurally COMPLETE against EcoCyc (12 edges, all five operator regions), so the divergence is one of parameterization rather than coverage.

derived.insight: v2ecoli's transcriptional-regulatory network covers 2198 of 4347 mRNA cistrons - 50.6%. It is 4209 edges from 150 transcription factors onto 2231 distinct target names. ⛔ An earlier version of this finding reported 663 of 4347 (15.2%) from 47 TFs; that was measured from fold_changes.tsv ALONE and was wrong - see the correction note below.
